entities.name: Porros
entities.description: Prince of Sumifa and powerful songmage from Almaaz who betrayed the songmages and was cursed into an immortal sand wraith.

entities.name: Samor
entities.description: Songmage who taught Porros, bound the cockatrice, and was killed by him.

entities.name: Sumifa
entities.description: City Porros was to inherit, buried under sand by his rage.

entities.name: Songmages
entities.description: Order of mages that Porros joined and betrayed.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Brother Samor was summoned to at Sarraza.

entities.name: Sarraza
entities.description: Mountain where Samor bound the rogue cockatrice.

entities.name: Beast of the Hours
entities.description: Cockatrice Porros summoned and later schemed to release.

entities.name: Ogwater Rifkin
entities.description: Banished the cockatrice using song-magic in 3050 AR.

entities.name: Fall of Sumifa
entities.description: Burial of Sumifa under a sandstorm drawn by Porros.

entities.name: Nessian Caves
entities.description: Shelter to which Sumifa's people fled.

events.summary: Samor finds Porros tangled in a treetop after a failed flight and Porros demands to be taught; he is accepted and named the Raptor.
events.quote: Samor gave him the title "the Raptor"

events.summary: Porros warns Samor and summons him to Sarraza, where Samor binds the cockatrice; Porros is later revealed as the traitor who summoned it and disrupted the ritual.
events.quote: Porros later revealed himself to be a traitor to the songmages.

events.summary: Porros steals the amulet key to the binding; Samor transforms him into a sand-wraith-like raptor.
events.quote: then cast a spell of transformation on Porros

events.summary: Porros slashes Samor's throat with broken mirror.
events.quote: Porros slashed Samor's throat with a piece of broken mirror

events.summary: Porros draws a sandstorm that buries Sumifa while its people flee to the Nessian Caves.
events.quote: Sumifa was buried under tons of sand

events.summary: Porros, immortal, schemes in 3050 AR to release the Beast of the Hours; Ogwater Rifkin foils him.
events.quote: his plans were foiled by Ogwater Rifkin

relations.quote: demanding Samor teach him the ways of the songmages

He was eventually accepted into their ranks
